requirement: When a promotion's end date passes, it should automatically flip to Expired so customers stop seeing it.
hidden_intent: Nightly scheduled job (flow or Apex) that sets Promotion status to Expired where End Date < today and status is Active. Canceled promos stay canceled. No notifications needed.

expect.notes: Scheduled flow on Promotion__c; filter Status=Active AND End_Date__c < TODAY; must not touch Canceled; no existing automation does this.
